description: The chart titled “Average performance on November 2024 AMC 10/12 tests” illustrates average test scores for a set of language models, with bars colored by model size category. The horizontal axis contains the model categories (rotated labels) in the displayed order: Llama-3.3 70B Instruct, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Qwen 2.5 14b-Instruct, GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Qwen 2.5 72b-Instruct, Gemini Flash 1.5, Gemini Pro 1.5, and phi-4; there is no explicit x-axis label. The vertical axis is labeled “Average score (temperature = 0.5)” and uses a linear scale spanning roughly from 60 to 95, with visible tick marks at 60, 70, 80, and 90. Each category has a single bar with a numeric value printed above it and small black error bars: Llama-3.3 70B Instruct is light blue at 66.4; Claude 3.5 Sonnet is light blue at 74.8; Qwen 2.5 14b-Instruct is dark blue at 77.4; GPT-4o is light blue at 77.9; GPT-4o-mini is dark blue at 78.2; Qwen 2.5 72b-Instruct is light blue at 78.7; Gemini Flash 1.5 is dark blue at 81.6; Gemini Pro 1.5 is light blue at 89.8; and phi-4 is dark blue at 91.8. A legend in the upper-left indicates light blue corresponds to “Large model” and dark blue corresponds to “Small model.” The bars are not shown as stacked or grouped beyond the single series per category, and there is no explicit sorting cue beyond the presented left-to-right order; no bars appear specially highlighted beyond the color encoding and the value annotations.
